methodology.scoring: Each company is scored 0-100 for fit against EACH Black Duck portfolio product independently. The recommended LEAD product is the weighted-max across products; default lead is Black Duck SCA/SBOM unless a stronger Defensics (protocol/safety) or Coverity (large embedded codebase) signal dominates.
methodology.note: No company list was supplied with the task (no input file, issue, or PR). The companies below are a representative archetype set drawn directly from the rubric (connectivity-SoC vendor, consumer-device + app brand, automotive Tier-1, server/BMC builder, industrial/edge vendor, robotics/autonomy stack) to demonstrate the per-product scoring and lead-selection logic. Swap in a real list to regenerate.
